notes.title: Minor Update v1.1.1 (Creator Contest ends soon)
notes.notes:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Buildings can now have a demolish award. Demolishing a Triplex will now award 200 Nanites. This gives you a method to convert 225 energy into 150 nanites on demand.
[*] Added display area for subscribed map pack author name and icon in the play menu.
[*] [Community Feedback] Added "Capture Mouse" option to general options
[/list]

[h1]Tweaks and Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] [Community Feedback] Fixed Float parser so that typing ".2" turns into "0.2" instead of incorrectly becoming "2".
[*] Fixed a bug whereby setting a map icon wouldn't work the second time.
[*] Fixed Capture Energy/Nanite Award action modifiers not properly applying.
[/list]

[b]Notice[/b]: The Creator Contest will close in less than two weeks on [i]September 30th![/i]

notes.title: Byte Builder Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]New Content: Custom Maps[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Jail Break[/b]: Break free from prison by corrupting other prisoners to your will and avoiding or deactivating security.
[*] [b]Byte Command[/b]: A Missile Command style arcade map where you defend with your base with rays from approaching enemies.
[*] [b]Gari’s Game[/b]: Play both sides of a battle and defeat a player of your choosing as quickly as possible.
[*] [b]Byte Bound[/b]: A Bound or Frogger style map where you must avoid a series of hazards to reach the end.
[*] [b]Grand Stand[/b]: Protect your base from waves of enemy attack and between rounds buy buildings and upgrades.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42453031/68d2ba20846b1a85e009c68b435019ffd6a25295.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42453031/c2637bbeba2d988df922bc45e0b92ef34d6aadc3.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42453031/0a0ab68ee81fc56401c0e931443089af473f58b8.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42453031/b57eabb959c899581178ca5c6ed5ba019386179b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42453031/aaa5e53b379c3a70d22809baeba4e7b4c772b292.png[/img]

[*] [b]Steam Workshop support[/b]: One-click subscription makes it easy to play and share community made map packs!
[/list]

[h1][b]Map Editor[/b][/h1]

[h3]New Game Mechanics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player actions (Turret, Energy Reactor, Relay, etc…) can be assigned a cooldown, charges, and max charge count. Charges are refunded upon demolishing a building of that type.
[*] Retaliation Damage: When a building takes damage it can reflex a fraction of that damage back to the attacker.
[*] Mid-level action modifiers: Modify your buildings mid-level for wacky effects, powerups, and super abilities.
[/list]
[h3]Editing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Quick and Easy map creation tools!
[*] Fully Customizable player action bar and configurable building modifiers.
[*] Editor Actions: Mirror, cut, paste, undo, and more make level design easy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42453031/ba31b8a624dcf966cffa93737dbe049a3eb14847.png[/img]
[*] Programmable player AI actions, responses, and difficulty ramping.
[*] Player Action Recording and Playback
[*] Map Scripting: Enables map packs of equal or greater complexity to the main campaign. For a full list of features visit our [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oPvf_L8CRdiyJH6m26Hx4cOwxmhpj5DEAlzMoIcOQMs]Editor Guide[/url].
[*] Persistent state across maps in a map pack enable cross-map choices and effects.
[/list]
[h3]Buildings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Blockade: [b]New building[/b] deals retaliation return damage to attackers.
[*] Shield: Now featuring hundreds of bubble placement configurations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42453031/27d855f3c523fc0df62c32ca0046cfb934066b0d.png[/img]
[*] Turret: Quad attack enables attacking multiple (up to 4) directions at once.
[*] Turret: Attack chaining to connected buildings
[*] Destroying or capturing a building can now provide resource bounty in custom maps
[/list]
[h3]Constructions (non-destructible buildings)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Relays (up to 8 relays in a network)
[*] Energy Reactor
[*] Nanite Fountain
[/list]
[h3]Terrain[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pits
[*] Walls
[/list]
[h3]Tutorial Videos[/h3]
We've recorded some tutorial videos to get you started with the editor. 
[previewyoutube=GoFrqokdhsg;leftthumb]YouTube Playlist[/previewyoutube]




[h1][b]Byte Builder Competition[/b][/h1]

Do you have what it takes to make an awesome Byte Lynx map pack? If so, then enter your map to our [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GngZrdfCZ0pYTp3174Dy8S81wnby4z9buCfbvWfgiOI]Byte Lynx Map Builder Competition[/url] for a chance to win prizes and prestige! The Competition runs for the month of September!

[h1][b]Major Gameplay Changes[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Added destroyed building SFX/VFX feedback for all buildings in the game.
[*] Improvised player Input handling.
[*] [Community Feedback] Dialogue now has reader options so that you can configure its behavior. Defaults to (Pause game always) and (Click to advance). The previous behavior is still available if you change the the settings to (Pause game on hover) and (Auto advance).
[/list]

[h1][b]Tweaks and bug fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [Community Feedback] Slight tweaks and bug fixes for Impact Mission.
[*] [Community Feedback] Altered voltage dialogue in Prologue: Traitor Mission.
[*] [Community Feedback] New upgrade for Prologue: Traitor Mission.
[*] [Community Feedback] Fixed Bug related to gossamer being captured in Backdoor Mission.
[*] [Community Feedback] “Get Resources” AI cards fixed, both in editor and campaign. It should now work more consistently.
[*] [Community Request] Added new tab to Main Menu Editor called Workspace Management which makes managing your Workspace a bit easier. Especially if you wish to switch between working on different map packs.
[*] Updated Journey map template to include a ping trail.
[*] Fixed major AI targeting bug.
[*] Added “Kill” and “Mourn” trigger type to Building Triggers. Kill will fire when a specific player receives kill credit for destroying a building (killing blow). Mourn will fire once the Target Player’s building is killed by another player. Could be used for tracking kills or to differentiate between destroyed (via demolish) and killed buildings.
[*] Added Ping and Ping Trail Map Actions!
[/list]

notes.title: A long awaited progress update
notes.notes:
Sorry for the long silence! We've been hard at work adding way more features to the map editor than originally intended. We don't want to confirm any features until they're in and working up to our standards, but there's a lot of cool stuff in there that we think you'll have a great time with.

Something we are comfortable showing off is our mass edit features:
[previewyoutube=J0HqQ0Oo31s;full][/previewyoutube]
We want making maps to be much easier and faster for you than it was for us, and this is a major step in that direction. 

We're also adding a fair number of things that will affect gameplay in custom maps. We're going to save the details on that for a future update and none of these are 100% guaranteed to be in the finished editor, but here are some things we've been working on:
A trigger editor,
Custom objectives,
Custom upgrades,
1.5 new buildings,
Mission packs

New schedule:
Begin playtesting sometime in June, with a publicly available version sometime in August.

notes.title: Byte Lynx Map Editor Progress Update
notes.notes:
We've been hard at work making a map editor and we wanted to share our progress. So far we have expanded in-game building placement to support map-building items like Relays and resource patches. We've also made progress on UI for editing additional data structures like upgrades, players, and AIs. There's still a lot of work to do to bring it all together, but we're happy with the progress so far.

As for a timeline, we're expecting to have something we're testing with fans in about a month, with a version everyone can use sometime in April.

notes.title: Santa Lynx Update (v1.0.6)
notes.notes:
Santa Lynx Update (v1.0.6)

General Changes
Added Steam community avatars.
Level design tweaks to ‘Wanted’ and ‘Invasion’ missions to incorporate pits into the gameplay.
Added visual indicators on platform block connectivity.
Added seasonal Christmas Decorations (Shown till Jan 3rd)
Misc. visual/audio polish.
New excessive difficulty modifiers: Garbage Collector, Make It Count, Wire Material, and Reactor Mode.
Other Excessive Difficulty Modifier quality of life improvements.

Community feedback changes
Added wide and ultra-wide monitor support
Removed an energy miner that is off the edge of one of the maps.
[Discord Game Suggestion] Some terrain on missions with pits/water/drop-offs now does not block the line of sight, enabling attacks over the otherwise un-buildable terrain.
Fixed a bug whereby lances would sometimes bypass a shield bubble and damage the second space for a single attack.
Fixed a bug whereby a moving platform that gets captured would glitch out.
Fixed AI on Aftermath [Expert] where it wouldn’t do anything.

notes.title: Byte Lynx v1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Byte Lynx v1.0.5[/h1]

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Excessive Difficulty Modifiers to Profile Menu. (100% on Expert to unlock)
Added modifiers: 
[list]
[*] Turn off firewall
[*] Overclocking
[*] Shields Only
[*] Windows XP
[*] Fair and Balanced
[/list][*] Added in-game time display.
[*] Added profile stat for total time playing on that profile.
[*] Upgrade Balance: “+150% Nanite miner burst duration”  -> “+175% Nanite miner burst duration”
[*] Upgrade Balance: “+10% Energy miner income” -> “+20% Energy miner income”
[*] Upgrade Balance: All platform health upgrades are nerfed. Platform spear is still viable, just less OP.
[*] Fixed bug whereby Reset All in the controls didn’t properly update/show the changes made.
[/list]

[h2]Community feedback changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Upgrade Clarity: “+150% Nanite miner burst” -> “+150% Nanite miner burst duration”
[*] All Income upgrades now modify the credit +# threshold instead of just the rate at which you get credits. The average income is unaffected.
[*] Fixed old tip text referencing “Campaign Menu” -> “Profiles Menu”.
[*] Fixed AI killing itself with a Surger pushed platform by accident.
[*] Escaping to in-game menu will now clear camera movement inputs.
[*] Tweaks to trigger timings on Lost Cause’s final attack.
[*] Extra lose states and dialogue for some unusual player actions.
[*] Escape now will move down the chain of menus while on the Main Menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Byte Lynx is out now! Post release plans.
notes.notes:
Byte Lynx is officially released! What's next for Artful Games?

EDIT (10/21/2022): After listening to community requests and conducting a poll we are making a level editor instead of a free 3-5 mission mini-campaign. The editor will come with a few ready-to-play example levels, just not up to main campaign quality.

Join our Discord (https://discord.gg/CmpSMpKRca) for updates and input on the level editor and more details on editor functionality.

If the game does really well we would love to make a sequel and bring you our most requested feature: Multiplayer. 

In the short term, we'll be fixing bugs, balancing levels, and maybe, just maybe, catching up on some sleep.

Happy gaming!
